experience.label: Experience
experience.dapper_summary: Full-stack engineer on a B2B SaaS platform used across 10+ Latin American markets.
experience.dapper_1: Led the consolidation of 3 country-specific applications into one configuration- and feature-flag-driven multi-country architecture in about a month, contributing to growth from 3 to 10+ markets in roughly 6 months.
experience.dapper_2: Built and maintain 100+ automated tests with Vitest and React Testing Library, integrated with GitHub Actions CI/CD.
experience.dapper_3: Built type-safe REST integrations with Orval and TanStack Query, and authentication with NextAuth and JWT.
experience.dapper_4: Develop Python backend services with Django and FastAPI on PostgreSQL.
experience.dapper_5: Work with AWS services (ECS, RDS, S3, Lambda) and Docker, and debug production issues.
experience.freelance_summary: Building websites and applications for small businesses end-to-end, from requirements to frontend, backend, API integration and deployment.
experience.freelance_1: Built an e-commerce solution for Dulce Berlín with Next.js, Django and PostgreSQL, integrating the Wompi payment widget, webhooks, payment states and refund flows.
experience.freelance_2: Delivered websites and web apps with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Astro, Python and Django.
